intro: If you are in Ubon Ratchathani and want a central city hotel with clean, spacious rooms at a price that is still easy on the wallet, V Hotel Ubon Ratchathani is a name guests mention often · It sits on Chaeng Sanit Road in the city centre and opened in 2015 · Around 79 plain, modern rooms, free in-building parking, a gym and a small garden · Guests praise the cleanliness of the rooms and the friendly service most of all · From approx ฿800/night.

body.html: V Hotel Ubon Ratchathani is a city hotel that has been open since 2015 · The building sits on Chaeng Sanit Road in central Ubon Ratchathani, a location that makes getting around the city easy · The first thing guests mention is that the rooms are clean and more spacious than expected for the price — not lavish, but tidy, modern and well kept, which suits travellers here for work, errands or a stopover while touring southern Isan.

There are several room types, from Standard and Deluxe up to Premier and rooms with a balcony · Even the standard rooms are decently sized, with a large, comfortable bed and a fairly firm mattress · Bathrooms separate the wet and dry areas, with a good water heater and water pressure, plus a fridge and flat-screen TV · Guests single out the cleanliness, with housekeeping refreshing towels and tidying daily · The niggles that come up are some external or next-door noise in certain rooms, and the occasional review mentioning insects — though that is not the majority view.
"The room was very clean and spacious with a comfortable bed, the young man at reception spoke great English, and there is plenty of covered parking — superb value for a city hotel in Ubon."

The shared facilities here are fairly simple · There is a gym, a small garden and free covered parking inside the building, which is a big plus for guests arriving by car as it is convenient and secure · To be straight about it, there is no swimming pool and no full restaurant — breakfast is available for a fee with limited choices · If you expect resort-style amenities, this may not be the right fit, but if your priority is a clean room in a good central location at a fair price, that is V Hotel's strength.

Location is an advantage · The hotel is close to Funtastic World Ubon, an indoor amusement park within walking distance, and Huai Muang Park, just a couple of hundred metres away, which makes it handy for families with children · The Ubon Ratchathani Cultural Centre is nearby too · It is about 5 km from Ubon Ratchathani Airport, roughly a 10-minute drive · There are restaurants and convenience stores around for a bite, while Thung Si Muang park and the city-centre temples are a short drive away.

Straight talk: V Hotel Ubon Ratchathani suits travellers after a clean, good-value room in a central location more than those wanting a full-service luxury hotel · It scores 9.2 from 117 reviews on Trip.com and around 8.5 on Booking.com, which reflects genuine satisfaction, especially on cleanliness and service · The complaints that do come up are noise in some rooms, the limited breakfast, and the lack of a pool — all worth knowing before booking if you are expecting a resort.

A tip from following the reviews: if you are a light sleeper, ask for a higher floor or a side away from the main road to avoid noise · If you are travelling as a group or with children, the Deluxe or Premier rooms are roomier for a modest price difference · Arriving by car is very easy thanks to the free in-building parking · For breakfast, head out into the Chaeng Sanit area or near the market for a more authentic Ubon feel and better value than eating in-house.

faqTitle: Frequently Asked Questions — V Hotel Ubon Ratchathani

faq.q: Where is V Hotel Ubon Ratchathani and how do I get there?
faq.a: It is at 63 Chaeng Sanit Road, Nai Mueang, in central Ubon Ratchathani · It is within walking distance of Funtastic World Ubon and about 200 m from Huai Muang Park · The Ubon Ratchathani Cultural Centre and Thung Si Muang are a 5–10 minute drive · It is about 5 km from Ubon Ratchathani Airport, roughly a 10-minute drive, with free in-building parking.

faq.q: How much does V Hotel Ubon Ratchathani cost and what rooms are there?
faq.a: Rates start at approximately ฿800/night for a Standard Room · The Deluxe Room starts around ฿950, a room with a balcony around ฿1,050, and the largest Premier Room around ฿1,250 · Prices vary by season and package, so compare a few platforms before booking.

faq.q: Does V Hotel Ubon Ratchathani have a pool and breakfast?
faq.a: There is no swimming pool · There is a gym and a small garden · Breakfast is available for an extra charge with fairly limited choices, and many guests prefer to eat out in the Chaeng Sanit area instead · The hotel's strengths are clean rooms and free covered parking rather than resort-style amenities.

faq.q: What are the rooms like and are they clean?
faq.a: Rooms are plain and modern, larger than expected for the price, with a big, comfortable bed and a fairly firm mattress · Bathrooms separate the wet and dry areas with a good water heater and pressure · Guests particularly praise the cleanliness and daily housekeeping · A few reviews mention noise or insects, but that is not the majority view.

faq.q: Who is V Hotel Ubon Ratchathani best for?
faq.a: It suits travellers after a clean, good-value room in a central location — work trips, errands or family visits · Being near Funtastic World and Huai Muang Park makes it handy for families with children · Arriving by car is even easier thanks to free in-building parking · It is not ideal for those who want a pool and resort-style amenities.

faq.q: Anything to know before booking V Hotel Ubon Ratchathani?
faq.a: Guests note that some rooms catch road or next-door noise, so if you are sensitive to it, ask for a higher floor or a side away from the main road · There is no pool and breakfast is limited · Rooms fill fast during the Candle Festival and other city events, so book ahead and choose a free-cancellation rate to be safe.
